fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA)

fields.name: BRANCH ID
fields.description: Assigned code for the branch that onboards the customer (party).

fields.name: REPORTING DATE
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: COLLATERAL ID
fields.description: Unique reference number for the collateral

fields.name: LOAN CONTRACT ID
fields.description: Unique numbers assigned to lndividual loan contracts.

fields.name: CUSTOMER ID
fields.description: Customer unique id linked to the Loan contract

fields.name: COLLATERAL TYPE
fields.description: Type of collateral pledged for credit facility.

fields.name: REGISTRATION NUMBER
fields.description: e.g. LR Number, Motor vehicle registration number, etc.

fields.name: COUNTY CODE
fields.description: County code for the county where the property is located

fields.name: COLLATERAL OMV LCY
fields.description: The value of collateral. Open Market Value (OMV)

fields.name: COLLATERAL FSV LCY
fields.description: Forced Sale Value (FSV) of property

fields.name: COLLATERAL DISCOUNTED VALUE
fields.description: Discounted value of collateral as per CBK Prudential Guidelines

fields.name: AMOUNT CHARGED
fields.description: The Legal Charge Amount as per the regstered charge documents.

fields.name: COLLATERAL DISCOUNT RATE
fields.description: Discounted rate of the collateral as per CBK Prudential Guidelines.

fields.name: LTV RATIO
fields.description: % of collateral attached to the facility. Computed from the loan facility amount and the collateral value.

fields.name: PROPERTY VALUER NAME
fields.description: Name of valuer

fields.name: COLLATERAL LAST VALUATION DATE
fields.description: The date when the collateral was valued {e.g. Date captured on the latest valuation report}

fields.name: INSURED FLAG
fields.description: Is the collateral insured Y/N Flag

fields.name: INSURER NAME
fields.description: The name of the Insurance Company

fields.name: AMOUNT INSURED
fields.description: The Principal amount insured in LCY

fields.name: INSURANCE EXPIRY DATE
fields.description: Expiry date of the insured property

fields.name: GUARANTEE ISSUER
fields.description: If collateral is a guarantee, the issuer names/details. The list is expandable upto 5 Number - Minium precision length
